public_rationale: GPT-4 was released, and launch coverage documented strongly impressed reactions from identifiable users in different fields. That meets the ordinary meaning of the prediction. More restrained assessments show that the reaction was not universal, which Marcus did not require.
limitations: The accounts are illustrative, not a representative opinion survey.
Some early users had commercial interests.
Impressed reactions do not establish accuracy or dependable reasoning.

criteria.support_condition: Multiple contemporary users or reviewers report exceptional surprise or admiration after using GPT-4.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative launch-period evidence shows predominantly ordinary or disappointing reactions, without substantial evidence of the strongly impressed reception predicted.
